svg.title: Toolkit
svg.desc: Deep learning: PyTorch, timm, Hugging Face Transformers, scikit-learn. Computer vision: OpenCV, MediaPipe. Audio: Librosa, Torchaudio. Reinforcement learning: Stable-Baselines3, Gymnasium, PPO. LLMs and agents: Qwen2.5-Math, Ollama, BitsAndBytes 4-bit, SymPy. Data and MLOps: NumPy, Pandas, Docker, GitHub Actions, pytest, Modal, Azure VMs.
